conclusion: Exactly-two-dotted tree packets are abundant, not empty.  This is a complete local four-node tranche and neither a compact example nor a high-dimensional nonexistence theorem.

proof.adjacent_dotted_path: with remote dotted x, adjacent dotted y, finite z, selected inertia is Lorentzian and conjugate PD iff (4-x')(4-z')-4y'>0; x,y have ordered structural roles
proof.counting: exact conjugate ordering, monotone two-pointer inequalities, and an exact two-dimensional Fenwick dominance join; no floating-point comparisons
proof.cycle_gate: vacuous because every packet is a tree
proof.disjoint_dotted_path: for endpoint dotted products x,z and middle finite y, selected Lorentzian inertia is equivalent to (4-x)(4-z)-4y<0; conjugate PD is equivalent to the conjugate determinant >0
proof.integral_cartan_gauge: orient every tree edge as (-1,-c); propagation gives an integral Cartan matrix and a positive symmetrizer
proof.star: selected inertia is Lorentzian automatically; conjugate PD iff x'+y'+z'<4; x,y are unordered

scope.not_covered: two-dotted four-node packets with cycles; packets with at least three dotted edges; full rank-23--30 compatibility; orders, conductors, stable lattices, and Vinberg hosts
